listing.name: Retrofitted Bridge
listing.summary: Convert automated ships to crewed ships.
listing.aiSummary: Converts automated ships into crewed ships by replacing their hullmod.

description:
Retrofitted Bridge (v0.0.4)

Convert automated ships to crewed ships.

download here

requires LunaLib

This mods does 2 things

Allows you to salvage automated ships without the automated ships skill (but you still can't deploy them effectively because of the CR penalty).
You can instead, for a substantial credit cost, replace the automated ship hullmod with retrofitted bridge, which turns it into a crewed ship.

img

changelog
v0.0.4 (2025-09-13)
- changed skeleton/maximum crew cost to be more inline with other hullmods
- the orbital works checks now also works with anything that downgrades to orbital works
- compatible with AoTD vaults of knowledge
- you can also simply just turn off the check in data/config/settings.json

v0.0.3 (2025-03-28)
- recompile for for Java 17 and 0.98a-RC5

v0.0.2 (2025-03-18)
- some UI improvements

v0.0.1 (2024-07-01)
- initial release of Retrofitted Bridge
